summary.report_name: NVDA10 Atlas source-code implementation forensic report V2
summary.strict_question_answered: For each of the 1,716 Atlas ideas: mapped service, source-code status, test status, classification, evidence, notes.

field_meanings.atlas_id: Stable Atlas idea identifier from the 1,716-record Atlas corpus.
field_meanings.atlas_idea_text: Original Atlas idea text/excerpt used for row-level interpretation.
field_meanings.mapped_service: One of the active codebase’s 18 services assigned by the Atlas Bridge.
field_meanings.bridge_mapping_status: Whether this row has a usable Atlas Bridge mapping to one of the 18 services.
field_meanings.source_code_status: Whether the active codebase contains source-code behaviour for the Atlas idea under this report’s evidence rule.
field_meanings.test_status: Whether accepted per-Atlas tests exist, were added, were reused, or were not found.
field_meanings.classification: The single mutually exclusive plain-English state for this Atlas idea.
field_meanings.evidence: Paths, IDs, code/test ranges, proof commands, and receipts supporting the classification.
field_meanings.notes: Plain-English caveats, especially where old audit wording could be confused with source-code implementation.

classification_meanings.mapped_existing_in_source_code: Mapped to one of the 18 services; active-code source behaviour was found as existing code. This is included in the active codebase, but not counted as newly added source code.
classification_meanings.mapped_added_to_source_code: Mapped to one of the 18 services; accepted evidence links the Atlas idea to new or modified source-code behaviour.
classification_meanings.mapped_tests_exist_but_source_code_missi: Mapped to one of the 18 services; accepted tests exist, but source-code behaviour was not proven or appears incomplete by this report’s evidence rule.
classification_meanings.mapped_not_migrated: Mapped to one of the 18 services; no accepted per-Atlas source-code behaviour proof and no accepted per-Atlas test proof were found.
classification_meanings.mapped_not_traceable: Atlas idea exists, but mapping or evidence is too weak to classify safely.

method_limits: The report is evidence-led from accepted repo artefacts, repair ledgers, active-code records, tests, proof logs, and Bridge mapping files.
Bridge mapping alone is not treated as source-code implementation.
Audit closure wording alone is not treated as source-code implementation.
Existing source-code evidence and newly added source-code evidence are kept separate but both count as included in the active codebase source code.
Rows with no accepted per-Atlas source-code or test proof are classified as mapped_not_migrated rather than hidden behind audit-language labels.
